findings.location: l. 502-503 (M2) ; aussi intitule l. 499 et tableau 1 l. 172
findings.claim: With the same indices the joint SAGA-Muon needs the passes of MISO where MISO converges ($11.8$ against $11.9$, softmax with $\kappa=n$; SAGA: $20.2$) and fails where MISO fails ($\kappa\gg n$): it is not a spectral method.
findings.problem: Les trois chiffres viennent d'une experience a parametres non regles (pas de manuel c = 1/4, 3 graines, cible 1e-6), alors que la section 2.3 annonce des familles reglees, dix graines et la cible 1e-9 'where memory limits'. 'SAGA: 20.2' se lit comme un avantage de 1.7 que SAGA regle efface (11.4 passes sur la meme instance). 'fails where MISO fails (kappa >> n)' n'est vrai qu'au pas de manuel : a pas regles, sur les instances du papier ou kappa >> n, la methode jointe converge, ce que (M3) cite lui-meme (29.0 / 43.5 passes).
findings.evidence: muon/results/M6_summary.json : tol 1e-06, 3 graines ; 'SAGA (Euclidean), c = 1/4' 20.1, 20.2, 20.2 ; MISO 12.0, 11.9, 11.5 ; 'joint SAGA-Muon, c = 1/4' 11.8, 13.2, 11.7 ; a kappa/n = 10 rien n'atteint 1e-6 en 40 passes, SAGA compris. muon/results/M1_summary.json (consistency_m1_rows.py), meme instance soft-mem : SAGA regle 11.4 passes a 1e-6, 17.1 a 1e-9 ; instances a kappa >> n, pas regles : SAGA-Muon joint 29.0, 43.55 (9/10), 28.1, 20.3 contre MISO 42.7, 120.65, jamais (0/10), 29.15. muon/findings.md l. 403-404 : 'Its speed-up over SAGA at textbook steps [...] is MISO's, and tuned SAGA recovers it'.
findings.proposed_fix: With the same indices and untuned textbook-type steps (three seeds, target $10^{-6}$) the joint SAGA-Muon needs the passes of MISO where MISO converges ($11.8$ against $11.9$, softmax with $\kappa=n$; SAGA at $\gamma=1/(4R^2)$: $20.2$, tuned: $11.4$) and stalls where MISO stalls ($\kappa\gg n$); tuned, it converges there \finding{M3}: at batch one it acts as a Euclidean method, not a spectral one.
